title: the ground-loop survival proof asserts the quiet exit of a losing claimant, not the old loud refusal
intention: Arm 4 of test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py follows outline 5.3.5.2.1: a second ground loop that loses the claim writes nothing to the nohup log and exits 0, and the first loop keeps the lock; the arm asserts the quiet exit and is not deleted.
why: Measured by akiendelllinux on origin/main: test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py reds on 'the losing claimant's refusal GREW the nohup log: 0 -> 0 bytes' and 'the refusal names the claim, not a crash: tail: ''' because b38af5fd1852 (35711160e) made a second loop exit 0 quietly per Akien's Q#93 answer (outline 5.3.5.2.1), and its bounds left this proof out. No ticket covered it.
traces_to: Law 3 and Law 9: a proof that asserts a behaviour the system retired is red by construction; CP4 resolves the chafe.
how: In arm_four_legibility replace the two loud-refusal checks with: the nohup log did not grow; the loser's unit is not failed (systemctl --user show <unit>.service -p ActiveState -p Result); the first loop's pid is still alive and still the beat record's pid. The taken-unit-name half is unchanged. Update the arm's heading, and add a note beside the docstring's verbatim 0d16e513ff26 falsifier that the refusal is now quiet. Linux only.

clauses.claim: arm 4 of test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py asserts that a second ground loop writes nothing to the nohup log, exits without failing its unit, and leaves the first loop alive and still named by the beat record; it is red on main (the loud-refusal checks) and green after, on Linux

decisions.text: D1: arm 4's first half asserts the quiet exit (silence, unit not failed, survivor keeps the claim); the arm is kept.

out: cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop (b38af5fd1852 owns the behaviour and its proof)

measured.saw: On Windows the proof is red for an unrelated reason: bin/cairn test dies at CreateProcess of a systemd tool (it needs systemd-run --user and cgroup v2, and main() says RED when either is absent). The loud-refusal assertions are at lines ~534-538 (after > before, and a regex over 'claim|singleton|already|refus'). akiendelllinux measured the Linux red on origin/main.
measured.how: bin/cairn test cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py on Windows; read lines 506-566 and main()
